settings.title: Settings
settings.languageDesc: Choose your interface language. The app remembers your choice.

1.title: Welcome & Profile
1.desc: Tell us about your store so we can configure everything correctly.

2.title: GST & Business
2.desc: Add your GSTIN for tax-compliant invoices. You can skip if unregistered.

3.title: Payment
3.desc: Add your UPI ID so customers can scan and pay directly from invoices.

4.title: First Products
4.desc: Add at least one product or pick a sample pack to start invoicing.

5.title: Opening Stock
5.desc: Enter current quantities so your stock report is accurate from day one.

6.title: First Supplier
6.desc: Add a supplier to track purchases and send WhatsApp reorder messages.

7.title: First Invoice
7.desc: Create your first sale — this is the moment SmartStock activates for you.

step1.profileSmallDesc: Single owner, quick sale, few SKUs. Big buttons, simple view.
step1.profileBigDesc: Multi-staff, bulk import, dense tables, Excel/Tally import.

step2.gstinHelper: 15-character GST Identification Number. Leave blank if unregistered.
step2.legalNameHelper: Appears on GST invoices exactly as entered.
step2.fyHelper: Used for annual GST reports and GSTR-1 filing.
step2.skipGst: Skip — I don't have GST yet
step2.billOfSupplyNotice: Without a GSTIN, invoices will be issued as Bill of Supply. Customers cannot claim GST input credit. You can add your GSTIN anytime from Settings.
step2.eInvoiceDesc: Mandatory if annual turnover exceeds ₹5 crore. Integration will be completed in v1.5.
step2.turnoverHelper: Enter in rupees, e.g. 50000000 for ₹5 crore.

step3.qrTitle: UPI Payment QR on Every Invoice
step3.qrDesc: Customers scan once and pay instantly. Works with any UPI app.
step3.bankHelper: Displayed on invoice for NEFT/RTGS payments. Not stored securely — do not enter full number.
step3.skipNotice: Skipping payment step — invoices will print without a QR code. You can add UPI later from Settings.

stub.unblockNote: You can continue past this step now and come back to fill it in when you're ready.
stub.desc4: Picking products is the next step. We'll add a sample grocery pack you can edit, or you can type your own.
stub.desc5: Walk your shop and count what's on the shelf. Skip if you want to start from zero — you can update stock anytime.
stub.desc6: Add your main supplier's name and WhatsApp number so you can send one-tap reorder messages.
stub.desc7: Your first invoice. After this, you're a billing software customer.

step4.title: First Products
step4.seedError: Failed to seed products. Please try again.
step4.alreadyUsed: Already used: {{pack}} pack — clear and re-pick?
step4.importExcelDesc: Bulk-import your existing product list. Recommended for stores with many SKUs.
step4.manualMin3: Add at least 3 products to continue.
step4.manualError: Failed to save products. Please try again.

step5.title: Opening Stock
step5.skipExplain: Most shops skip this on day one. You can count your stock and update anytime from Inventory.
step5.noProductsHint: Go back to step 4 and add some products first.

step6.title: First Supplier
step6.illustrationDesc: Add your supplier's WhatsApp number and reorder with a single tap.
step6.name: Supplier Name
step6.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number.
step6.gstinHelper: For claiming input credit. Leave blank if unknown.
step6.gstinInvalid: Enter a valid 15-character GSTIN or leave blank.
step6.skipExplain: You can add suppliers anytime from the Suppliers section.
step6.saveError: Failed to save supplier. Please try again.
step6.savedDesc: {{name}} has been added. You can add more suppliers from the Suppliers section.

step7.title: First Invoice
step7.quickDesc: Walk-in customer, Cash payment. Takes 30 seconds.
step7.customPath: Build a real invoice instead (opens Quick Sale screen)
step7.noProducts: No products available — go back to step 4.
step7.saleError: Invoice could not be created. Please try again.
step7.successDesc: Your first invoice is ready. Share it on WhatsApp or view the PDF.
step7.activation: Your first invoice. After this, you're a billing software customer.
step7.addStaffNudge: Setup complete. Add staff accounts in Settings to get your team started.

productForm.saleByWeightHint: Enable for loose items (flour, rice, sugar). Customer specifies quantity on scale.
productForm.negativeStockHint: Negative stock allowed — shop-floor reality. Reconcile later.
productForm.reorderLevelHint: Alert fires when stock falls at or below this quantity. 0 = no alert.
productForm.packSizeHint: Optional — e.g. 1 for a "1 kg packet". Shown as a hint at sale time.
productForm.tareWeightHint: Container weight (e.g. cheese tub). Subtracted from gross weight at sale time.

errors.qtyMustBeWhole: {{unit}} requires whole numbers — no decimal quantity.
errors.hsnFormat: HSN must be 4, 6, or 8 digits, or leave empty.
errors.tareTooLarge: Tare weight must be less than current stock.
